cohort.provider_weighting: replicates within match, matches within provider, providers equally

hard_eligibility.d_metrics: D-F1, D precision and D recall exactly equal adopted due frozen D mask
hard_eligibility.macro_f1: at least adopted minus 0.001 in each view
hard_eligibility.short_spell_recall_iou_0_5_lt3s: at least adopted in each view
hard_eligibility.spell_f1: strictly above adopted aggregate in clean, v1 and v2

mixture.d_policy: predecode adopted f062 output once per cell; preserve this exact D mask for every recipe

poolings.arithmetic: weighted arithmetic mean of each expert's conditional H/A probabilities
poolings.log: weighted log geometric mean of conditional H/A probabilities, normalized

mixture.weights: CE + calibrated + adopted = 1; adopted is residual nonnegative weight

question: Can fixed mixtures of stage-512 CE, calibrated and adopted conditional H/A experts improve spell F1 across all views while limiting macro regression to 0.1 percentage point?

selection.rank: eligible recipes by v2 spell F1 descending, macro F1 descending, recipe_id ascending
selection.seed_diagnostic_shortlist: top two eligible pooled recipes plus the fixed CE=.5/calibrated=0/adopted=.5/arithmetic/HA3 anchor; deduplicate, max three; diagnostics never affect ranking
